title: Companion conversation jank check
description: Measures a native conversation on an Android device: open, stream a 200-delta turn sent from another client, then scroll back into the history, with adb gfxinfo framestats around each step (the jank.recipe.json method: a step fails below min_sustained_fps over any 500 ms of rendering; target_fps is reported, never failed on). Start native-stream-stack.mts (isolated gateway, synthetic Claude runner, no model), pair the app once with `PLATFORM=android ADB_SERIAL=<serial> node scripts/agentic/native-stream-proof.mjs pair`, then run with PLATFORM=android, ADB_SERIAL, METRO_PORT, NATIVE_STREAM_CONTROL and a new NATIVE_STREAM_STATE file. The streamed turn and the scroll also check the conversation's follow state from the app's proof frame. require_follow=no reports follow without checking it; a before/after frame-rate pair runs both builds that way. Run it on the development variant with video off: screenrecord's encoder competes with the app for the frames being measured. The drags start at a fixed point inside the transcript (540, 1000 device px on a 1080x2424 screen); ui.scroll swipes from the screen edge and starts in the status bar on Android.

min_sustained_fps.description: Fail a step whose lowest FPS over any 500 ms of continuous rendering is below this.

require_follow.description: no reports the follow state without checking it, for a build whose frame has none (before MANUAL-000190) and the frame-rate pair.

frames.description: off for an Android release build, which has no proof frame: frame-rate only, with require_follow=no.

proofTargets.claim: Streaming into and scrolling back through a native conversation hold the sustained FPS budget on this Android device; opening is measured and reported.
The reader follows the end while the turn streams and stops following after scrolling back (checked only with require_follow=yes).

setup.intent: Create a synthetic Claude session and seed its earlier turns.

open-start.intent: Start measuring the conversation's first render.

open.intent: Open the session by deep link and wait for its history.

at-end.intent: The rows rendered and the reader is at their end.

open-end.intent: Close the open window against its budget.

stream-start.intent: Start measuring while another client's turn streams in.

streams-following.intent: The streamed turn ends; every sample during it stayed at the end.

follow-checked-stream.intent: Claim follow only when this run checked it.

assert-streams-following.intent: The streamed turn reached the app and every follow check passed.

stream-end.intent: Close the streaming window against its budget.

stream-fps-sampled.intent: A 500 ms rendering stretch exists, so sustained FPS is measured.

scroll-start.intent: Start measuring the scroll back into the history.

scroll-1.intent: The reader drags back toward earlier turns while frames are measured.

scroll-1-settle.intent: Let the list come to rest.

scroll-2.intent: The reader keeps dragging back through the history.

scroll-2-settle.intent: Let the list come to rest.

scroll-3.intent: The reader keeps dragging back through the history.

scroll-3-settle.intent: Let the list come to rest.

scroll-4.intent: The reader keeps dragging back through the history.

scroll-4-settle.intent: Let the list come to rest.

scroll-end.intent: Close the scroll window against its budget.

scroll-fps-sampled.intent: A 500 ms rendering stretch exists, so sustained FPS is measured.

reader-away.intent: After scrolling back the reader no longer follows the end.

follow-checked-away.intent: Claim follow only when this run checked it.

report.title: Companion conversation jank
report.intent: Write the per-step report; a broken budget fails the run.

check.intent: Every measured step held its budget.
